cat > /workspace/dev/genbig.py << 'PYEOF'
import json, random, sys

kind = sys.argv[1]
out = sys.argv[2]
rng = random.Random(7)

if kind == 'stream':
    Q, L = 16, 8
    U = 2147483648
    R = 32
    borders = [0]
    step = U // R
    for r in range(1, R):
        borders.append(step * r)
    borders.append(U)
    steps = []
    t = 0
    nid = 0
    for k in range(40000):
        t += 1
        m = 3 if k % 3 else 8
        lanes = rng.sample(range(L), m)
        arrs = [{'id': 'pkt-%d-%d' % (k, j), 'lane': ln,
                 'rank': rng.randrange(U)} for j, ln in enumerate(lanes)]
        nid += m
        steps.append({'t': t, 'serve': True, 'arrivals': arrs})
    req = {'mode': 'stream', 'banks': Q, 'lanes': L, 'limit': U,
           'borders': borders, 'capacity': 20000, 'epoch': 40000,
           'steps': steps}
elif kind == 'stream2':
    # dense equal ranks, many updates, heavy backlog
    Q, L = 16, 8
    U = 40000
    borders = [0, 1, 2, 5, 100, 101, 1000, 1001, 5000, 5001, 10000, 10001,
               20000, 20001, 30000, 30001, 39999, 40000]
    steps = []
    t = 0
    nid = 0
    for k in range(40000):
        t += 1
        lanes = rng.sample(range(L), 3)
        arrs = [{'id': 'pkt-%d-%d' % (k, j), 'lane': ln,
                 'rank': rng.randrange(U)} for j, ln in enumerate(lanes)]
        nid += len(arrs)
        steps.append({'t': t, 'serve': (k % 2 == 0), 'arrivals': arrs})
    req = {'mode': 'stream', 'banks': Q, 'lanes': L, 'limit': U,
           'borders': borders, 'capacity': 20000, 'epoch': 1,
           'steps': steps}
elif kind == 'burst':
    Q, L = 16, 8
    U = 1000000
    borders = [0] + [U // 32 * r for r in range(1, 32)] + [U]
    pkts = [{'id': 'p-%d' % i, 'lane': rng.randrange(L),
             'rank': rng.randrange(U)} for i in range(120000)]
    req = {'mode': 'burst', 'banks': Q, 'lanes': L, 'limit': U,
           'borders': borders, 'start_bank': 3, 'packets': pkts}
elif kind == 'burst2':
    # all same rank: maximal tie overtakes
    Q, L = 16, 8
    U = 1000000
    borders = [0, 500000, U]
    pkts = [{'id': 'p-%d' % i, 'lane': rng.randrange(L), 'rank': 42}
            for i in range(120000)]
    req = {'mode': 'burst', 'banks': Q, 'lanes': L, 'limit': U,
           'borders': borders, 'start_bank': 0, 'packets': pkts}
elif kind == 'burst3':
    # single bank, single rank, worst case for prefix sums
    Q, L = 1, 1
    U = 1000000
    borders = [0, U]
    pkts = [{'id': 'p-%d' % i, 'lane': 0, 'rank': 7} for i in range(120000)]
    req = {'mode': 'burst', 'banks': Q, 'lanes': L, 'limit': U,
           'borders': borders, 'start_bank': 0, 'packets': pkts}
data = json.dumps(req).encode()
open(out, 'wb').write(data)
print(out, len(data), 'bytes')
PYEOF
cd /workspace && for k in stream stream2 burst burst2 burst3; do python3 dev/genbig.py $k tmp/big_$k.json; done
